system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In June 2024, what wording did Section 1567(2) of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code, as then in force, use to define the limits of punishing a child? Quote the wording.
raw_response:
As of June 2024, Section 1567(2) of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code provided that:

"A parent or guardian may administer reasonable correction to a child, but not such as would cause serious injury or death."

This wording defined the legal limits on corporal punishment of children under Thai law at that time.
